howto: Your snake always moves: steer it with the mouse, a finger or Left / Right.
Eat the glowing orbs to grow longer.
Cut across a rival so its head hits your body: it bursts into orbs for you.
Touch a rival's body or the wall and you burst instead.
tips: Grow before you fight: a longer snake wins head-on meetings.
Boost (Shift or Space) to cut a rival off, but it burns length.
Burst rivals leave a trail of orbs: sweep it straight away.
More rivals join as you grow, so keep away from the arena edge when it gets busy.

controls.keyboard: Mouse to aim, or Left / Right (A / D) to turn; hold Shift or Space to boost; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag to steer; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: An adaptive curve: you start against 3 rivals, one more joins for every 7 segments you grow (up to 9), and they speed up as you get longer.

cheats.effect: Slide through rival snakes; only the wall can burst you

features.one-tap-start: Play on the title, a tap anywhere, or Space
features.instant-restart: Play again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best length on the title card
features.tutorial-card: Two skippable coach cards on the first run (steer, then boost); Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Burst! screen with length, score, orbs, rivals burst, time and best length
